name: video-post
description: Post-production for talking-head video, run locally. Hand it raw footage and it asks for your brand font, colour and caption style, then cuts the dead air and fumbled takes, adds slow zooms, and captions it in your brand. You get a post-ready video plus an editable Premiere/Resolve timeline. Slides with a circular speaker cutout on request. Captions only, for an already-edited video, too.
